items.title: Full saved overview — European Union
kv: The European Union is a supranational legal and supervisory layer, while the Eurosystem owns euro central-bank money and national law still controls important authorization, property and insolvency outcomes. MiCA is effective and the maximum grandfathering period ended by 1 July 2026. EBA counted 39 e-money tokens issued under MiCA and zero authorized asset-referenced tokens as of 1 September. SG-FORGE publishes live EUR and USD e-money-token circulation and reserve composition; BBVA Spain operates bitcoin and ether trading and custody. By contrast, the 37-bank Qivalis consortium says its proposed issuer is still awaiting Dutch authorization and does not issue e-money or provide public payment services. EBA and ESMA's late-September MiCA-review submissions are recommendations, not amended law. Pontes launched with onboarded participants, but no first completed transaction was found; Project Agorá used real value in a controlled test but moved ordinary bank deposits through existing core systems rather than launching a common production token.

items.title: Authority
kv: The Parliament and Council legislate, the Commission administers and proposes revisions, EBA and ESMA coordinate and exercise assigned functions, national competent authorities authorize and supervise exact entities, and the ECB and national central banks govern euro central-bank money and TARGET Services. EU legislation, agency advice, national authorization, prudential supervision and Eurosystem settlement authority are separate layers and clocks.

items.title: Claims and backing
kv: At the observed 1 October disclosure EUR CoinVertible had €167,013,839.02 in circulation with reserves stated as 100 percent at Société Générale; USD CoinVertible had $12,546,441 in circulation with reserves stated as 87.67 percent at BNY and 12.33 percent at Société Générale. SG-FORGE describes one-for-one redemption, segregated collateral and daily reserve composition. These are issuer disclosures about the issuer's EMT liabilities and assets. BBVA-custodied bitcoin and ether are customer cryptoassets, and Qivalis's one-for-one backing remains a future design.

A reserve deposit is the issuer's or safeguarding structure's bank claim; it does not make the token holder a direct depositor of the reserve bank, create deposit insurance or establish stress-tested redemption.

The ECB also began preparatory work for possible own-funds investment in tokenized public-sector and EU-supranational securities with future Pontes settlement.

items.title: Cross border routes
kv: EU passporting and euro infrastructure are multinational, and Project Agorá tested a €10,000 treasury payment involving Lloyds, Deutsche Bank, CaixaBank and the Eurosystem. Across Agorá, 23 financial institutions and five central banks ran 17 scenarios in six currencies with about CHF 800,000 of real value and an average initiation-to-settlement time of one minute 20 seconds. The platform triggered movements in existing core bank systems rather than issuing a common production deposit token. Deutsche Bank also participates in Partior and describes future tokenized-deposit connectivity, but route-specific production receipts remain open.

A controlled real-value test is stronger than simulation but is not recurring production; platform messages, customer debits, correspondent funding, FX, central-bank settlement and beneficiary credit remain separate records.

authority.summary: The Parliament and Council legislate, the Commission administers and proposes revisions, EBA and ESMA coordinate and exercise assigned functions, national competent authorities authorize and supervise exact entities, and the ECB and national central banks govern euro central-bank money and TARGET Services. The Commission's MiCA consultation closed on 30 September, while EBA and ESMA submitted review recommendations; none amended MiCA at cutoff.
authority.boundary: EU legislation, agency advice, national authorization, prudential supervision and Eurosystem settlement authority are separate layers and clocks.

legal_objects.summary: The record distinguishes MiCA cryptoassets, asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens; bitcoin and ether held for customers; tokenized commercial-bank deposits; ordinary deposits moved after experimental platform messages; DLT-native debt securities; regulated CSD entitlements; euro central-bank money; and a possible future digital euro. SG-FORGE's CoinVertible products are private EMT liabilities, Qivalis is a prospective private EMT, and Pontes settles eligible tokenized-asset transactions in central-bank money without converting securities into money.
legal_objects.boundary: Euro denomination or token form does not make an issuer liability, bank deposit, security entitlement and ECB liability the same claim.

permitted_activities.summary: MiCA governs covered issuance and cryptoasset services, while electronic-money, banking, payment, investment-service, DLT-market-infrastructure, custody and settlement activities retain separate permissions. BBVA says its Spanish service covers customer-initiated bitcoin and ether execution, transfer and custody. SG-FORGE acts under electronic-money-institution, investment-firm and CASP statuses. Qivalis is not yet authorized and therefore does not issue e-money or provide public payment services.
permitted_activities.boundary: One authorization, group membership or product whitepaper does not permit every activity or every affiliate.

entry_gates.summary: MiCA issuer and CASP authorization, national authority action, electronic-money or banking status, DLT-infrastructure authorization, whitepaper notification, Eurosystem eligibility, participant onboarding and CSD/TARGET access are separate gates. The maximum transitional period ended by 1 July 2026. ESMA warns that a whitepaper in its interim register is not authority approval. Qivalis applied to De Nederlandsche Bank but remained outside the authorization gate.
entry_gates.boundary: Register appearance, application, authorization, passporting, technical connection, first transaction and recurring production are distinct.

named_operating_actors.summary: Named actors include SG-FORGE as a live EMT issuer and regulated service entity; BBVA Spain as a bank crypto-service provider; Deutsche Bank, Lloyds, CaixaBank and the Eurosystem in a Project Agorá real-value route; EIB, Clearstream, DekaBank, Eurex Clearing and Bundesbank in the completed DLT-collateral circuit; and 37 banks in the pre-authorization Qivalis consortium. UniCredit reports tokenized-asset transactions, while Intesa's disclosed crypto and token plans remain strategic.
named_operating_actors.boundary: A group name or consortium roster does not prove that every member issues, safeguards, distributes, settles or holds the asset.

claims_and_backing.summary: At the observed 1 October disclosure EUR CoinVertible had €167,013,839.02 in circulation with reserves stated as 100 percent at Société Générale; USD CoinVertible had $12,546,441 in circulation with reserves stated as 87.67 percent at BNY and 12.33 percent at Société Générale. SG-FORGE describes one-for-one redemption, segregated collateral and daily reserve composition. These are issuer disclosures about the issuer's EMT liabilities and assets. BBVA-custodied bitcoin and ether are customer cryptoassets, and Qivalis's one-for-one backing remains a future design.
claims_and_backing.boundary: A reserve deposit is the issuer's or safeguarding structure's bank claim; it does not make the token holder a direct depositor of the reserve bank, create deposit insurance or establish stress-tested redemption.

domestic_rails.summary: TARGET Services, T2S-reachable CSDs, ECMS and national-central-bank operations form the euro public settlement and collateral spine. The €77.5 million EIB security entered a completed Clearstream/ECMS/Bundesbank collateral circuit. Pontes launched on 21 September with an initial onboarded participant group to connect admitted market DLT platforms to TARGET Services. The ECB also began preparatory work for possible own-funds investment in tokenized public-sector and EU-supranational securities with future Pontes settlement.
domestic_rails.boundary: Launch, onboarding and an investment plan do not prove a Pontes transaction, securities purchase, recurring volume or exception performance.

cross_border_routes.summary: EU passporting and euro infrastructure are multinational, and Project Agorá tested a €10,000 treasury payment involving Lloyds, Deutsche Bank, CaixaBank and the Eurosystem. Across Agorá, 23 financial institutions and five central banks ran 17 scenarios in six currencies with about CHF 800,000 of real value and an average initiation-to-settlement time of one minute 20 seconds. The platform triggered movements in existing core bank systems rather than issuing a common production deposit token. Deutsche Bank also participates in Partior and describes future tokenized-deposit connectivity, but route-specific production receipts remain open.
cross_border_routes.boundary: A controlled real-value test is stronger than simulation but is not recurring production; platform messages, customer debits, correspondent funding, FX, central-bank settlement and beneficiary credit remain separate records.

operating_state.summary: MiCA is effective; SG-FORGE EMTs and BBVA Spain's crypto service are live; the EIB collateral circuit completed; Pontes is technically launched with onboarded participants. Project Agorá completed controlled real-value tests. Qivalis remains an unauthorized applicant, Intesa's stated crypto expansion remains plan-period strategy, the ECB tokenized-securities investment is preparatory, and the digital euro remains unissued.
operating_state.boundary: Effective law, authorized product, production service, controlled test, technical launch, planned investment, authorization application and sovereign issuance are different states.

scale.summary: Available denominators measure different things: EBA counted 39 MiCA EMTs and zero authorized ARTs as of 1 September; SG-FORGE reports exact dated circulation for two products; Qivalis has 37 bank members; the EIB collateral circuit was €77.5 million; and Project Agorá used about CHF 800,000 across 17 scenarios. None is total EU stablecoin capitalization, custody assets, redemption volume, tokenized-deposit balances or recurring wholesale throughput.
scale.boundary: Token count, circulation, consortium membership, single-transaction notional and test value cannot be summed into market scale.

stress.summary: EBA identifies concentration in crypto lending around two stablecoins, possible circumvention of the EMT interest prohibition and an EMT-like token whose issuer chose not to seek authorization. ESMA seeks stronger tools against unauthorized third-country services, fraud sites and non-compliant stablecoins. No reviewed primary source established a run, reserve shortfall, failed redemption, custody deficit, Pontes fail, Qivalis loss or bank tokenized-deposit failure.
stress.boundary: A supervisory vulnerability or proposed power is not an observed loss, and bounded absence in public sources is not proof that no customer experienced loss.

correction_and_loss.summary: MiCA, e-money, banking, investment-service, custody, securities, CSD, TARGET and national property and insolvency rules allocate different remedies. An erroneous chain transfer, issuer liability-book error, false whitepaper, reserve-bank failure, CASP custody shortfall and TARGET error would engage different actors. SG-FORGE's stated segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness remain issuer disclosures requiring instrument and national-law verification; no observed failure supplied a tested waterfall.
correction_and_loss.boundary: EU authorization does not create a single loss waterfall, and a chain record does not by itself decide legal title, redemption or settlement correction.

evidence_boundary.summary: This card is current through 13:25:37 EDT on 1 October 2026 for the reviewed EU, Eurosystem and bank-primary sources. It establishes the common regime, named supranational infrastructure and selected bank products but cannot replace national layers. Late-September EBA and ESMA papers are advice; Qivalis's website supplies an explicit negative authorization statement; SG-FORGE figures are dated issuer disclosures; and no Pontes first-transaction receipt was found.
evidence_boundary.boundary: The EU card does not by itself answer firm-specific permission, safeguarding, title, tax, insolvency or enforcement outcomes in any member state.
